recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized portrait of a bearded man rendered in dark ink outlines over a vibrant, textured magenta and deep purple wash. The style combines fine-line sketching with heavy stippling and organic, watercolor-like bleeding edges to create a gritty, psychedelic aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white facial features against a dense, dark textured background
Organic ink line-work merging with abstract color washes
Tight, right-aligned typography balanced against a centered subject
coreInvariants: Monochromatic magenta/purple color palette for the mid-tones
Heavy black ink for shadows and hair texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered bust-up portrait filling 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and nose, rendered with the highest level of white space and detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright face, moves outward through the dark curls of hair, and settles on the top-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with dense, textured color and stippling.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and deep purple washes providing the primary mood and mid-tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink for structural lines and deep shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for facial highlights and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purples contrasted with low-value black and high-value white.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to magenta, purple, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif or geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text to maintain a clean, modern contrast to the messy illustration.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 70s era and heavy, rounded aesthetic.
Provides the soft, rounded vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a beard in a 1970s psychedelic ink style. Use heavy black stippling and line art over a textured magenta and purple watercolor wash. The face should be high-contrast white. The overall texture should look like a vintage screen-printed album cover with paper grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned text in the top right corner using a heavy, rounded slab-serif font in solid white. Ensure the text is tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the background a mix of magenta and purple?
Is the text right-aligned in the top right?
Does the image have a grainy, ink-bleed texture?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no digital artifacts in the grain
Verify the text is legible against the texture
Check that the magenta doesn't veer into red or orange
Confirm the ink lines feel organic and hand-drawn
recipe.reuseFormula: Psychedelic Ink Portrait [Subject] + Magenta/Purple Wash + Heavy Stippling + Right-Aligned Bold Slab Serif Typography
